mapper.sql: FROM ddc_i18n_page p JOIN ddc_namespace n ON n.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND n.id = p.namespace_id AND n.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
AND p.biz_code = #{scope.bizCode} AND n.namespace_code = #{scope.namespaceCode} AND p.env_code = #{scope.env} AND p.app_code = #{scope.appCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ddc_biz WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND biz_code = #{scope.bizCode} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE
SELECT id FROM ddc_namespace WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND biz_code = #{scope.bizCode} AND namespace_code = #{scope.namespaceCode} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE
SELECT id FROM ddc_env WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND env_code = #{scope.env} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE
SELECT id FROM ddc_app WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND biz_code = #{scope.bizCode} AND app_code = #{scope.appCode} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE
